sentences.text: The Group Insurance Benefits Booklet says its Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit pays funeral expenses incurred up to S$2,000 if Daniel dies as a result of an accident, on receipt of proof of death and the relevant documents in the insurer’s prescribed form; it can be claimed only under either the Core Scheme or the Voluntary Scheme.

The booklet does not specify which particular documents the prescribed form requires, and the uploaded documents do not establish whether Daniel is enrolled in the Core or Voluntary Scheme, so the funeral benefit’s applicability to him is unresolved.
Daniel’s certificate lists Group Personal Accident of S$300,000 as of 1 April 2024, but that dated amount does not establish the funeral benefit or confirm cover on a later date.

next_steps: Contact Aldermoor Life Ltd (through the employer or scheme administrator, for this group scheme) about the Civil Service Group Insurance Scheme - Certificate to ask what it needs for a claim.

Section 5 - Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit
If an Insured Person dies as a result of an Accident, we will pay the funeral expenses incurred, up to $2,000,
on receipt of proof of death and the relevant documents in our prescribed form.
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or the Voluntary Scheme.
Section 6 - Repatriation
We will pay up to $5,000 for the cost of bringing the Insured Person's body home if death occurs overseas.
